plan.title: Scholarship Scheme Progress by District
plan.subtitle: Overview of approvals, pending cases, and scheme distribution across districts

panels.title: Total Applicants
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants

panels.title: Approval Rate by District
panels.sql: SELECT "District" AS district, ROUND(100.0*NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN "Status"='Approved' THEN 1 END),0)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),2) AS approval_rate FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 8

panels.title: Pending Cases by District
panels.sql: SELECT "District" AS district, COUNT(*) AS pending_cases FROM scholarship_applicants WHERE "Status"='Pending' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 8

panels.title: Top 10 Pending Applicants
panels.sql: SELECT "Sr No" AS sr_no, "Naam" AS name, "School" AS school, "District" AS district, "Status" AS status FROM scholarship_applicants WHERE "Status"='Pending' ORDER BY "Sr No" LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: The dashboard shows the overall progress of scholarship schemes across districts. The first KPI displays the total number of applicants. The bar chart on the left illustrates the approval rate per district, highlighting which areas have the highest success rates. The right bar chart focuses on pending cases, indicating districts where more applicants are awaiting decision. Finally, the table lists the top 10 pending applicants, providing quick access to individual records for follow‑up. All figures are dynamic and update as new data is entered into the system.
